digital technologies are an enabler for CE transition through servitization, but only when the servitization business model is usage focused.
digital technologies are enablers of the CE in usage focused business models, and that they can be used to mitigate some of the drawbacks of usage focused business model in the context of the CE.
the IoT, big data, and analytics are enablers of the CE within the context of usage focused business model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the digital technologies are key enablers of the CE within servitized business models.
the usage focused business model enables CE by leveraging the functionalities of digital technologies.
digital technologies enable the CE through usage focused business models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
digital technologies are not just enablers of servitization and CE, but also enablers of their integration.
digital technologies can help companies to implement CE through the usage focused business models by overcoming the limitations of the latter.
the functionalities enabled by digital technologies are not limited to the implementation of a usage focused business model but can be leveraged to support the adoption of a CE approach.
